scope: parking (parking, stopping and standing a vehicle, and where each is not allowed)

vocabulary.definition: The person operating a motor vehicle on the road.
The part of the road set aside for pedestrians to safely cross the road, marked or unmarked.
A space set aside for pedestrians waiting for buses, streetcars, and trolleys, marked by raised buttons or markers on the road.
A lane for bicyclists only that runs alongside vehicle traffic, typically marked by a single solid white line and signs.
Any place where one road meets another road.
An intersection where traffic travels in one direction around a central island.
A special lane reserved for carpools, buses, motorcycles, or low-emission vehicles with decals.
A posted sign stating that parking is not allowed where it is posted.

rules.title: Signal when pulling to or from the curb
rules.when: pulling next to the curb OR pulling away from the curb
rules.action: signal before moving
rules.statement: WHEN pulling next to the curb OR pulling away from the curb, the DRIVER MUST signal before moving.
rules.note: 9.37 words this as 'You should signal'; 11.16 gives the plain command 'Activate the turn signal before pulling up to the curb'. The stronger wording is recorded.

rules.title: Check behind when pulling into a space or to the curb
rules.when: stopping to pull into a parking space OR pulling up to the curb OR pulling away from the curb
rules.action: check traffic behind using the rearview mirror, side mirrors, and turning the head
rules.statement: WHEN stopping to pull into a parking space OR pulling up to the curb OR pulling away from the curb, the DRIVER MUST check traffic behind using the rearview mirror, side mirrors, and turning the head.

rules.title: Check blind spots when leaving a space
rules.when: about to leave a parking space OR pull out from the curb OR parallel park
rules.action: check blind spots by looking over the right and left shoulders
rules.statement: WHEN about to leave a parking space OR pull out from the curb OR parallel park, the DRIVER MUST check blind spots by looking over the right and left shoulders.

rules.title: Turn off and set the parking brake
rules.when: the vehicle has been parked
rules.action: turn off the vehicle and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle has been parked, the DRIVER MUST turn off the vehicle and set the parking brake.
rules.note: Stated after the parallel parking steps.

rules.title: Look before opening the door
rules.when: about to open the door and exit a parked vehicle
rules.action: look carefully for passing vehicles, bicycles, and motorcycles and check blind spots, and exit only when safe
rules.statement: WHEN about to open the door and exit a parked vehicle, the DRIVER MUST look carefully for passing vehicles, bicycles, and motorcycles and check blind spots, and exit only when safe.
rules.note: 13.40 also says to check for motorcyclists before opening the door next to traffic.

rules.title: Bicycle lane may be used to park
rules.when: parking where parking is permitted next to a BICYCLE LANE
rules.action: drive in the BICYCLE LANE
rules.statement: WHEN parking where parking is permitted next to a BICYCLE LANE, the DRIVER MAY drive in the BICYCLE LANE.
rules.note: Exception to the rule that driving in a bicycle lane is illegal. 10.83 says to check blind spots before entering a bike lane.

rules.title: Choose a large enough space
rules.when: looking for a space to parallel park
rules.action: look for a space at least three feet longer than the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN looking for a space to parallel park, the DRIVER MUST look for a space at least three feet longer than the vehicle.

rules.title: Signal intent to park
rules.when: the DRIVER has found a space to parallel park
rules.action: turn on the signal to show the intent to park and keep it on while pulling up alongside
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has found a space to parallel park, the DRIVER MUST turn on the signal to show the intent to park and keep it on while pulling up alongside.

rules.title: Pull up alongside the vehicle in front
rules.when: preparing to parallel park
rules.action: pull up alongside the vehicle in front of the space leaving about two feet between the vehicles, and stop once the rear bumper is aligned with the front of the parking space
rules.statement: WHEN preparing to parallel park, the DRIVER MUST pull up alongside the vehicle in front of the space leaving about two feet between the vehicles, and stop once the rear bumper is aligned with the front of the parking space.

rules.title: Check before backing in
rules.when: about to back into a parallel parking space
rules.action: look in the rearview mirror and over the shoulder for approaching vehicles and pedestrians
rules.statement: WHEN about to back into a parallel parking space, the DRIVER MUST look in the rearview mirror and over the shoulder for approaching vehicles and pedestrians.

rules.title: Back in at about 45 degrees
rules.when: backing into a parallel parking space
rules.action: turn the steering wheel to back into the space at about a 45-degree angle
rules.statement: WHEN backing into a parallel parking space, the DRIVER MUST turn the steering wheel to back into the space at about a 45-degree angle.

rules.title: Straighten out within 18 inches of the curb
rules.when: backing into a parallel parking space AND the rear wheel is within 18 inches of the curb
rules.action: begin turning the steering wheel away from the curb, pulling forward and backward as needed, so the vehicle ends parallel to and within 18 inches of the curb
rules.statement: WHEN backing into a parallel parking space AND the rear wheel is within 18 inches of the curb, the DRIVER MUST begin turning the steering wheel away from the curb, pulling forward and backward as needed, so the vehicle ends parallel to and within 18 inches of the curb.
rules.note: The final position is worded 'should now be parallel and within 18 inches of the curb'.

rules.title: Brake and park gear on a hill
rules.when: parking on a hill
rules.action: set the parking brake and leave the vehicle in park, or in gear for a manual transmission
rules.statement: WHEN parking on a hill, the DRIVER MUST set the parking brake and leave the vehicle in park, or in gear for a manual transmission.
rules.note: Reason given: the vehicle could roll due to equipment failure.

rules.title: Sloping driveway
rules.when: parking on a sloping driveway
rules.action: turn the wheels so the vehicle will not roll into the street, leave the vehicle in park and set the parking brake
rules.statement: WHEN parking on a sloping driveway, the DRIVER MUST turn the wheels so the vehicle will not roll into the street, leave the vehicle in park and set the parking brake.

rules.title: Headed downhill
rules.when: parking headed downhill
rules.action: turn the front wheels into the curb or right toward the side of the road
rules.statement: WHEN parking headed downhill, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels into the curb or right toward the side of the road.

rules.title: Headed uphill
rules.when: parking headed uphill next to a curb
rules.action: turn the front wheels away from the curb (left, towards the center of the road) and let the vehicle roll back a few inches so the wheel gently touches the curb
rules.statement: WHEN parking headed uphill next to a curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the front wheels away from the curb (left, towards the center of the road) and let the vehicle roll back a few inches so the wheel gently touches the curb.

rules.title: Hill without a curb
rules.when: parking headed uphill OR downhill AND there is no curb
rules.action: turn the wheels to the right so the vehicle will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail
rules.statement: WHEN parking headed uphill OR downhill AND there is no curb, the DRIVER MUST turn the wheels to the right so the vehicle will roll away from the center of the road if the brakes fail.

rules.title: White curb
rules.when: stopped at a white painted curb
rules.action: stop longer than needed to pick up or drop off passengers
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at a white painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop longer than needed to pick up or drop off passengers.
rules.note: Handbook: 'Stop only long enough to pick up or drop off passengers.'

rules.title: Green curb
rules.when: parked at a green painted curb
rules.action: park longer than the limited time posted on signs or painted on the curb
rules.statement: WHEN parked at a green painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT park longer than the limited time posted on signs or painted on the curb.

vague_terms.explanation: the handbook says the limit 'may' be posted; no default limit given

rules.title: Yellow curb: loading only
rules.when: at a yellow painted curb
rules.action: stop other than to load and unload passengers and freight, or stop longer than the time posted
rules.statement: WHEN at a yellow painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop other than to load and unload passengers and freight, or stop longer than the time posted.

rules.title: Yellow curb: stay with noncommercial vehicle
rules.when: stopped at a yellow painted curb
rules.action: usually stay with the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN stopped at a yellow painted curb, the DRIVER of a noncommercial vehicle MUST usually stay with the vehicle.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when staying with the vehicle is not required

rules.title: Red curb
rules.when: at a red painted curb
rules.action: stop, stand, or park
rules.unless: the vehicle is a bus AND the red zone is marked for buses only
rules.statement: WHEN at a red painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop, stand, or park, UNLESS the vehicle is a bus AND the red zone is marked for buses only.

rules.title: Blue curb
rules.when: at a blue painted curb
rules.action: park
rules.unless: the DRIVER is a disabled person OR is driving a disabled person, AND the vehicle displays a special placard or special license plate
rules.statement: WHEN at a blue painted curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT park, UNLESS the DRIVER is a disabled person OR is driving a disabled person, AND the vehicle displays a special placard or special license plate.
rules.note: Inferred from 'Parking for a disabled person or someone driving a disabled person with a special placard or special license plate' under 'special parking rules'.

rules.title: No Parking sign
rules.when: a NO PARKING sign is posted
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle where the sign applies
rules.statement: WHEN a NO PARKING sign is posted, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle where the sign applies.

rules.title: Not on a crosswalk
rules.when: at a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle on the CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN at a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle on the CROSSWALK.

rules.title: Not on a sidewalk
rules.when: parking next to a sidewalk
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle on the sidewalk or partially blocking the sidewalk
rules.statement: WHEN parking next to a sidewalk, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle on the sidewalk or partially blocking the sidewalk.

rules.title: Not in front of a driveway
rules.when: parking near a driveway
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle in front of the driveway
rules.statement: WHEN parking near a driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle in front of the driveway.

rules.title: Not near a disabled sidewalk ramp
rules.when: within three feet of a sidewalk ramp for disabled persons
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within three feet of a sidewalk ramp for disabled persons, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Not at a wheelchair access curb
rules.when: at a curb that provides wheelchair access to a sidewalk
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle in front of or on that curb
rules.statement: WHEN at a curb that provides wheelchair access to a sidewalk, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle in front of or on that curb.

rules.title: Not in the crosshatched area by a disabled space
rules.when: next to a designated disabled parking space with a crosshatched (diagonal lines) area
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle in the crosshatched area
rules.statement: WHEN next to a designated disabled parking space with a crosshatched (diagonal lines) area, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle in the crosshatched area.

rules.title: Zero-emission vehicle spaces
rules.when: at a space designated for parking or fueling zero-emission vehicles
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle in the space
rules.unless: the DRIVER is driving a zero-emission vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN at a space designated for parking or fueling zero-emission vehicles, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle in the space, UNLESS the DRIVER is driving a zero-emission vehicle.

rules.title: Not in a tunnel or on a bridge
rules.when: in a tunnel OR on a bridge
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN in a tunnel OR on a bridge, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle, UNLESS signs permit parking there.

rules.title: Fire hydrant and fire station driveway
rules.when: within 15 feet of a fire hydrant OR a fire station driveway
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 feet of a fire hydrant OR a fire station driveway, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Near a crosswalk
rules.when: within 20 feet of a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 20 feet of a marked or unmarked CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle.
rules.note: The same block gives 15 feet where a curb extension is present; see PARK-PROH-12. The two distances could be read as the 15-foot rule replacing the 20-foot rule at curb extensions.

rules.title: Near a crosswalk with curb extension
rules.when: within 15 feet of a CROSSWALK where a curb extension is present
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle
rules.statement: WHEN within 15 feet of a CROSSWALK where a curb extension is present, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle.

rules.title: Between safety zone and curb
rules.when: there is a SAFETY ZONE next to the curb
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle between the SAFETY ZONE and the curb
rules.statement: WHEN there is a SAFETY ZONE next to the curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle between the SAFETY ZONE and the curb.

rules.title: No double parking
rules.when: a vehicle is already parked at the curb
rules.action: double park beside it
rules.statement: WHEN a vehicle is already parked at the curb, the DRIVER MUST NOT double park beside it.

rules.title: Not on the wrong side of the street
rules.when: parking on a street
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle on the wrong side of the street
rules.unless: there is an emergency OR a law enforcement officer requires a stop OR a stop is specifically permitted
rules.statement: WHEN parking on a street, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle on the wrong side of the street, UNLESS there is an emergency OR a law enforcement officer requires a stop OR a stop is specifically permitted.

rules.title: Not on a freeway
rules.when: on a freeway
rules.action: park or leave the vehicle
rules.unless: there is an emergency OR a law enforcement officer requires a stop OR a stop is specifically permitted
rules.statement: WHEN on a freeway, the DRIVER MUST NOT park or leave the vehicle, UNLESS there is an emergency OR a law enforcement officer requires a stop OR a stop is specifically permitted.
rules.penalty: A vehicle stopped, parked, or left standing on a freeway for more than four hours may be removed.

rules.title: Public transit bus areas
rules.when: at an area or lane designated by signs for public transit buses only
rules.action: drive, stop, park, or leave the vehicle in that area
rules.unless: the DRIVER is crossing the bus lane to make a right turn
rules.statement: WHEN at an area or lane designated by signs for public transit buses only, the DRIVER MUST NOT drive, stop, park, or leave the vehicle in that area, UNLESS the DRIVER is crossing the bus lane to make a right turn.

rules.title: Do not stop in the middle of a crosswalk
rules.when: stopping at a CROSSWALK
rules.action: stop in the middle of the CROSSWALK
rules.statement: WHEN stopping at a CROSSWALK, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop in the middle of the CROSSWALK.
rules.note: Reason given: it could force a blind pedestrian to walk into traffic outside the crosswalk.

rules.title: Do not block an intersection
rules.when: there is not enough space to completely cross an INTERSECTION before the traffic signal light turns red
rules.action: stop in or block the INTERSECTION
rules.statement: WHEN there is not enough space to completely cross an INTERSECTION before the traffic signal light turns red, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop in or block the INTERSECTION.

rules.title: Never stop on railroad tracks
rules.when: at a railroad crossing
rules.action: stop on the railroad tracks, or begin proceeding without enough room to completely cross the tracks
rules.statement: WHEN at a railroad crossing, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop on the railroad tracks, or begin proceeding without enough room to completely cross the tracks.

rules.title: Do not stop when merging onto a highway
rules.when: entering a highway from an on-ramp
rules.action: stop
rules.statement: WHEN entering a highway from an on-ramp, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop, UNLESS stopping is absolutely necessary.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when stopping is necessary

rules.title: Do not stop in a roundabout
rules.when: travelling in a ROUNDABOUT
rules.action: stop
rules.statement: WHEN travelling in a ROUNDABOUT, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop.

rules.title: Flashers when stopping for vehicle trouble
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: turn on the emergency flashers, or the turn signals if the vehicle has no emergency flashers
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST turn on the emergency flashers, or the turn signals if the vehicle has no emergency flashers.

rules.title: Pull off the road
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: pull off the road away from all traffic, if possible
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST pull off the road away from all traffic, if possible.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when pulling off is impossible

rules.title: Stop where visible
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble AND cannot get completely off the road
rules.action: stop where people can see the DRIVER and the vehicle from behind
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble AND cannot get completely off the road, the DRIVER MUST stop where people can see the DRIVER and the vehicle from behind.

rules.title: Not over a hill or around a curve
rules.when: the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: stop just over a hill or just around a curve
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER needs to stop because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST NOT stop just over a hill or just around a curve.
rules.note: Reason given: other drivers may not see the vehicle in time.

rules.title: Call for help and stay in the vehicle
rules.when: the DRIVER has stopped because of vehicle trouble
rules.action: call for emergency roadside assistance and stay in the vehicle until help arrives
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER has stopped because of vehicle trouble, the DRIVER MUST call for emergency roadside assistance and stay in the vehicle until help arrives.
rules.note: See PARK-EMER-11 for freeway situations where getting out is safer.

rules.title: Stopping on a freeway
rules.when: the DRIVER must stop on a freeway
rules.action: park completely off the pavement and stay in the vehicle with the doors locked until help arrives
rules.statement: WHEN the DRIVER must stop on a freeway, the DRIVER MUST park completely off the pavement and stay in the vehicle with the doors locked until help arrives.
rules.penalty: A vehicle stopped, parked, or left standing on a freeway for more than four hours may be removed.

rules.title: Disabled on freeway: right shoulder
rules.when: the vehicle stops working on a freeway
rules.action: safely pull over to the right shoulder
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle stops working on a freeway, the DRIVER MUST safely pull over to the right shoulder.

rules.title: Disabled on freeway: use the right side
rules.when: the vehicle is disabled on a freeway shoulder AND the DRIVER must get out of the vehicle
rules.action: exit and re-enter the vehicle on the right side away from traffic, and return to the vehicle as soon as possible
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is disabled on a freeway shoulder AND the DRIVER must get out of the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST exit and re-enter the vehicle on the right side away from traffic, and return to the vehicle as soon as possible.

rules.title: Disabled on freeway: stay belted inside
rules.when: the vehicle is disabled on a freeway shoulder
rules.action: stay inside the vehicle with the seat belt on until help arrives
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is disabled on a freeway shoulder, the DRIVER MUST stay inside the vehicle with the seat belt on until help arrives.

rules.title: Disabled on freeway: flashers optional
rules.when: the vehicle is disabled on a freeway shoulder
rules.action: use the emergency flashers at the DRIVER's discretion
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is disabled on a freeway shoulder, the DRIVER MAY use the emergency flashers at the DRIVER's discretion.
rules.note: Handbook notes they help other vehicles see you at night and in different weather conditions.

rules.title: Disabled on freeway: when to get out and stay away
rules.when: the vehicle is disabled on a freeway AND there is not enough space on the shoulder OR there is a guardrail OR there is an area to safely stay away from freeway lanes
rules.action: get out of the vehicle and stay away from it
rules.statement: WHEN the vehicle is disabled on a freeway AND there is not enough space on the shoulder OR there is a guardrail OR there is an area to safely stay away from freeway lanes, the DRIVER SHOULD get out of the vehicle and stay away from it.
rules.note: Handbook: 'it is safer to get out of your vehicle and stay away'.

rules.title: Pulling over for law enforcement
rules.when: stopped by a law enforcement officer
rules.action: move completely onto the right shoulder, even if in the HOV LANE, and stop in a well-lit area when possible
rules.statement: WHEN stopped by a law enforcement officer, the DRIVER MUST move completely onto the right shoulder, even if in the HOV LANE, and stop in a well-lit area when possible.

vague_terms.explanation: does not say when a well-lit area is not possible

rules.title: Pulling off in thick fog
rules.when: fog becomes too thick to drive safely
rules.action: consider pulling off the road, activating the emergency flashers and waiting for conditions to improve
rules.statement: WHEN fog becomes too thick to drive safely, the DRIVER SHOULD consider pulling off the road, activating the emergency flashers and waiting for conditions to improve.

rules.title: No unattended young children
rules.when: leaving a parked vehicle AND a child six years old or younger is in the vehicle
rules.action: leave the child unattended in the vehicle
rules.unless: the child is left under the supervision of a person who is at least 12 years old
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a parked vehicle AND a child six years old or younger is in the vehicle, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave the child unattended in the vehicle, UNLESS the child is left under the supervision of a person who is at least 12 years old.

rules.title: No children or animals in a hot vehicle
rules.when: leaving a parked vehicle that is hot or sitting in the sun
rules.action: leave children or animals in the vehicle, even with a window slightly open
rules.statement: WHEN leaving a parked vehicle that is hot or sitting in the sun, the DRIVER MUST NOT leave children or animals in the vehicle, even with a window slightly open.
rules.note: Handbook says it is dangerous and illegal.
